name: Hypselospinus
sum: An iguanodontian from the Early Cretaceous of southern England, first described in 1889 as Iguanodon fittoni.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; from specimens bought by the Natural History Museum, London, in the 1880s.
material: Several specimens from the Wadhurst Clay and nearby units.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Norman 2010
